machine.offsetHandling: firmware: commands are in the active nozzle's build coordinates; do not subtract the nominal offset again

start: ;Firmware owns Griffin startup; this export does not request routine bed leveling.

exportGuidance.header: Use a complete Griffin header, including GENERATOR.BUILD_DATE, the active tool's MATERIAL.GUID and BUILD_VOLUME.TEMPERATURE. The accepted PLA demo uses Generic PLA GUID 506c9f0d-e3aa-4bd4-b2d2-23e2425b1aa9 and build-volume temperature 28 C.
exportGuidance.troubleshooting: A file rejected as missing necessary data may have incomplete metadata even when libCharon accepts it. Compare with a Cura S5 export; UFP contains /3D/model.gcode.
exportGuidance.acceptance: User reports on 2026-09-08 that the final wedge change achieved the requested Ultimaker behavior: no bed leveling and no heating of the unused nozzle. Preserve this envelope, including Griffin compatibility 4.4.0, material identity and build-volume metadata. This observation does not establish complete print quality or physical clearance.

nonplanar.basis: Bounded working limit for surface-following layers with this fixed vertical nozzle. Set from an early inclination working range; it is not a measured clearance rating and no head collision model is implemented.
nonplanar.validation: software limit only; no physical print has established it

startup.validation: standard S5 Griffin startup without a per-job leveling routine is assumed; installed firmware and verification are optional metadata

machine.validation: software definition; no physical print validation
